name: Shyness
overview: Scripture encourages believers to overcome shyness by embracing the fruit of the Spirit, including gentleness and faith, which empower boldness in relationships and service. Paul’s example in Philippians urges Christians to forget past fears and press forward confidently in their calling. Prayer with thanksgiving replaces anxiety, enabling believers to present their needs to God without hesitation. Additionally, Hebrews reminds us to welcome others warmly, even strangers, as a practice of faith, while James calls for active obedience to God's Word, moving beyond mere hearing to courageous living.
